quarterly_data.quarter: NVIDIA press release: NVIDIA Launches OpenShell Reference Architecture for Safe (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: NVIDIA (release): the NVIDIA OpenShell Reference Architecture for safe AI agents is now available, combining Vera Rubin NVL72 infrastructure (which NVIDIA says delivers 30x higher throughput per megawatt for agentic workloads), Vera CPUs (2x the performance of x86 processors, per NVIDIA) running OpenShell, and BlueField-4 DPUs running NVIDIA Sentry for in-silicon enforcement, which NVIDIA says boosts agent capacity by up to 20%. System makers Dell Technologies, Cisco, HPE, Lenovo and Supermicro are building infrastructure with it, cloud providers including CoreWeave, Crusoe, Lambda, Nebius, Nscale, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and Vultr are deploying OpenShell-ready infrastructure, and security vendors including CrowdStrike, Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler and Fortinet are integrating support; ServiceNow announced general availability of ServiceNow Arc enforced by OpenShell.
quarterly_data.figure: Vera Rubin NVL72 30x higher throughput per megawatt for agentic workloads
